message:
Parse raw address string in VariableUnserializer::matchString

Summary: For APC serialization, if the string is a static string, instead of recording the contents of the string, we just record the raw memory address of this string. This diff makes it so that `matchString` function can read this format, hence preventing it from punting to the slower path.

Reviewed By: markw65

Differential Revision: D15529273
